notes: Single town, whole-year one calendar, no district split. Each day cell carries a plain-text label (Restmüll/Bio/Papier/grüner Punkt/Sperrmüll/Altholz/Problemmüll) rather than a colour code; the background shading (orange weekends, yellow bands) is decorative/week-numbering, not a bin marker, so only labelled cells were counted. 'Bio Sommer' (a weekly summer-season Biotonne pickup, Jun-Sep) was counted under bio like plain 'Bio'. Feb 24 and Sep 25 each carry two labels in one cell ('Papier/Problemmüll' and 'grüner Punkt/Sperrmüll'); both bins were recorded for those dates. 'Altholz' (Jan/Mar/Sep) and 'Elektro- u. Kühlgeräte' (Feb 10, Sep 9) have no matching key and were left out, as was the one-off 'Häckselaktion' (Mar 14, a branch-chipping drop-off event rather than a Grünschnitt bin route). All counted dates cross-checked against their printed weekday letters against 2026-01-01=Thursday; no mismatches.
